title: The Girl from Ipanema
hook: Why Girl from Ipanema feels like *a lazy summer day*
cover_text: The chord that *slides like a sigh*

chords.name: Fmaj7
chords.text: Home: *Fmaj7*. Sun, sand, nowhere to be.

chords.name: G7
chords.text: *B natural* sneaks in: a lift, like a breeze.

chords.name: Gm7
chords.text: *B slips to B♭*. The breeze drops.

chords.name: Gb7
chords.text: *G♭7* replaces C7. Bass and top slide down.
